claims.title: Load a noncommuting code with a calibrated counterterm; expose and repair a restricted-control trap

quoted_fields.interface: A closed coherent finite-code model, bounded positive finite-band Q, known G and calibrated matrix counterterm eta^2*G^*Q^-1*G. The full-code ramp has no extra penalty selecting a proper subcode. The repair additionally requires separate off-code source gating and the complete time-dependent cross-counterterms. Use well-defined unitary propagators and fixed input/output code isometries.
quoted_fields.failure: A dressed eigenstate and zero Berry self-connection do not imply reachability under restricted controls. Bare-penalty gap collapse alone is not a time lower bound; the explicit nearly invariant vector supplies that stronger result. Uniform state error in bandwidth/mode count/coupling strength does not bound work, slew, noise or calibration. Exact Stage II invariance does not validate perturbed hardware. No native endpoint-only Jacobi interface, physical apparatus, novelty, practical advantage or all-N capacity-two theorem is acquired. N998 and earlier different gapless-response interfaces remain unchanged.
